mushrooms.title: 5 Core Ingredients
mushrooms.subtitle: Mushrooms long used in traditional East Asian food culture, extracted using modern methods.

cordyceps.name: Cordyceps
cordyceps.description: Native to the Himalayan highlands, Cordyceps has been a prized food ingredient in Tibetan traditional food culture for hundreds of years. Its unique life cycle has long made it a marvel of nature.

lions_mane.name: Lion's Mane
lions_mane.description: With its distinctive lion's mane-like appearance, Lion's Mane has long been used in traditional Chinese, Korean, and Japanese cuisine and food culture.

reishi.name: Reishi
reishi.description: Reishi has a history of thousands of years in Chinese and Korean traditional food culture, known as the 'Mushroom of Immortality.' Its beautiful glossy appearance frequently appears in artwork.

chaga.name: Chaga
chaga.description: Growing in cold birch forests of Siberia and Northern Europe, Chaga has been used for centuries as a tea ingredient in Russian and Scandinavian traditional beverage culture.

turkey_tail.name: Turkey Tail
turkey_tail.description: Characterized by its vibrant striped pattern resembling a turkey's tail, Turkey Tail is one of the most studied mushrooms worldwide. In Chinese traditional medicine, it is called 'Yunzhi' (雲芝) with a long food culture history.

about.title:
Where Tradition Meets
Modern Science
about.description1: MYCO BLEND was born from inspiration drawn from thousands of years of East Asian mushroom food culture. We refine 5 traditionally revered mushrooms using modern extraction techniques to create a premium blend that can be easily enjoyed in everyday life.
about.description2: All raw materials are harvested sustainably, and each batch is independently verified by third-party labs for purity and β-glucan content. Our mission is to honestly deliver the best that nature has to offer to your table.

process.title: Rigorous 4-Step Manufacturing
process.subtitle: We compromise on nothing at every stage for the highest quality product.

harvest.title: Harvest
harvest.description: Mushroom fruiting bodies cultivated in optimal growing environments are harvested at peak β-glucan content. All raw materials are sourced through a traceable supply chain.

extract.title: Extract
extract.description: Dual extraction using both water and alcohol captures both water-soluble and fat-soluble compounds. Low-temperature processing minimizes loss of active compounds.

verify.title: Verify
verify.description: Independent third-party certifiers verify β-glucan content, heavy metal absence, mycotoxin safety, and microbial standards separately. Batches failing standards are fully discarded.

blend.title: Blend
blend.description: Five extracts are precisely weighed and mixed in optimal ratios at a GMP-certified facility. Nitrogen-flushed packaging ensures freshness.
